Gaucher's Disease Agents -  AZM 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-525287  
Guideline Name 
Gaucher's Disease Agents - AZM  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:NON-PREFERRED: Cerdelga  
Diagnosis 
Type 1 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Type 1 Gaucher disease  


--- PDF page 710 ---
Page 710 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is one of the following as detected by a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-
cleared test:  
• 
CYP2D6 extensive metabolizer  
• 
CYP2D6 intermediate metabolizer  
• 
CYP2D6 poor metabolizer  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims confirming a history of 
failure or intolerance to generic miglustat (AG is preferred)  
 
Product Name:NON-PREFERRED: Cerezyme  
Diagnosis 
Type 1 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Type 1 Gaucher disease that results in one or more of the following 
conditions:  
• 
Anemia  
• 
Thrombocytopenia  
• 
Bone disease  
• 
Hepatomegaly or splenomegaly  
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims confirming a history of 
failure or intolerance to BOTH of the following:  
• 
generic miglustat (AG preferred)  


--- PDF page 711 ---
Page 711 
• 
Elelyso  
 
Product Name:NON-PREFERRED: Cerezyme  
Diagnosis 
Type 3 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Type 3 Gaucher disease  
 
AND 
 
2 - Presence of a non-central nervous system (CNS) manifestation (e.g., moderate to severe 
anemia, thrombocytopenia, bone disease, hepatomegaly, or splenomegaly)  
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: Elelyso; NON-PREFERRED: Vpriv  
Diagnosis 
Type 1 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Type 1 Gaucher disease  
 
AND 
 
2 - For VPRIV requests ONLY: Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid 
claims confirming a history of failure or intolerance to BOTH of the following:  


--- PDF page 712 ---
Page 712 
• 
generic miglustat (AG preferred)  
• 
Elelyso  
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: generic miglustat (AG/Authorized Generic); NON-
PREFERRED: Brand Zavesca, Yargesa, generic miglusat  
Diagnosis 
Type 1 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of mild to moderate Type 1 Gaucher disease  
 
AND 
 
2 - For Non-Preferred Requests ONLY: Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or 
paid claims confirming a history of failure or intolerance to generic miglustat (AG is preferred)  
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: generic miglustat (AG/Authorized Generic), Eleyso; NON-
PREFERRED: Cerdelga, Cerezyme, Vpriv, Brand Zavesca, Yargesa, generic miglusat  
Diagnosis 
Type 1 Gaucher Disease, Type 3 Gaucher Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Documentation of positive clinical response to therapy
